project.title: Microbial community of an anoxic lab scale biortickling filter
project.description: Characterization of the microbial community that remained firmly attached on the packing material and in solution of an anoxic lab scale biotrickling filter removing Volatile organic compounds. DNA were used as proxies for the total and active microbial community
